edge_cases: Missing required form fields cause a Bad Request error.
Attempting to register with an existing username returns "Username already exists".
Login with an unknown username or wrong password returns "Invalid credentials".
Creating a project for a non‑existent user returns "User not found".
Adding a task to a non‑existent project returns "Project not found".
Database connection failures or SQL errors result in generic failure messages.
contract.intent: Expose a web API for user registration, login, and basic project‑task management using HTTP requests.
invariants: Usernames are unique; duplicate registration attempts are rejected.
Passwords are stored only as bcrypt hashes, never in plain text.
A project can be created only if the supplied username exists in the users table.
A task can be added only if the referenced project exists.
All database connections and cursors are closed before the request finishes.
io_behavior: POST /register with username, password, confirm_password returns a plain‑text success, duplicate‑user, or failure message.
POST /login with username and password redirects to /dashboard on success or returns "Invalid credentials" on failure.
POST /create_project with project_name, description, username returns a plain‑text success, user‑not‑found, or failure message.
POST /add_task with project_name, task_name, task_description returns a plain‑text success, project‑not‑found, or failure message.
GET /view_tasks?project_name=... returns a JSON array of task records for the specified project.
side_effects: Inserts a new row into the users table on successful registration.
Commits a new project row linked to an existing user on successful project creation.
Commits a new task row linked to an existing project on successful task addition.
Performs database rollbacks on any INSERT error.
Issues an HTTP redirect response on successful login.

rationale: Core functionality works and most contract requirements are met, but error messages for non‑existent user/project differ from the specification and explicit transaction rollbacks are not implemented.
